summary: ICICI Bank Limited filed a Form 6-K disclosing the pricing of USD 300 million senior unsecured fixed-rate notes under its USD 7.5 billion Global Medium Term Note Programme. The notes carry a 5.352% coupon, mature August 13, 2031, and are unsecured. Proceeds will fund general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation. The notes will be listed on Indian IFSC exchanges.
